title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: config_put still uses local_admin check, not coap_oscore_auth_mutating
description: In coap_server.c:209-239, config_put() uses the old pattern: lichen_coap_is_local_admin() check followed by raw payload read. Unlike deaddrop_post and msg_inbox_post, it was NOT updated to use coap_oscore_auth_mutating(). Per spec/17 (LCI), /config is a mutating resource that should support both local admin and OSCORE-protected mesh peers. Fix: convert to coap_oscore_auth_mutating().
close_reason: Fixed (commit 9206da5fb7 on beads-worker-2). coap_server.c config_put() now gates after authorize_mutating(): if (!is_protected && !lichen_coap_is_local_admin(addr, addr_len)) -> 4.01 via lichen_coap_respond — mirrors sibling msg_post in the same file and modular coap_config.c:765. NOTE for the record: the current coap_oscore.c authorize_mutating (:483) already rejects non-admin plaintext, so the live tree was safe; this adds the handler-level defense-in-depth Mark's comment asked for, robust to helper-contract regressions (which have happened under merges). Tests: NEW suite lichen/tests/coap_config_put_auth (native_sim ztest, compiles coap_server.c directly, --wrap=coap_resource_send + --wrap=coap_oscore_authorize_mutating, mock is_local_admin) — 4 tests: (1) regressed-helper + non-admin -> 4.01, callback never fires [FAILS on pre-fix code: negative control verified by stripping the gate and rebuilding]; (2) regressed-helper + admin -> callback fires, 2.04; (3) contract-helper non-admin -> 4.01 propagates; (4) no-callback -> 4.04 preserved. 4/4 PASS; neighbor suite coap_lci_auth 11/11 PASS. Codereview 3x delegated to kimi-k3 (correctness/security/edge): all PASS round 1 (convergence). Build environment: heft Zephyr 4.1.0 native_sim/native/64.
